pr_title: repart: Switch to new mkfs.btrfs subvolume API
pr_body:
In https://github.com/kdave/btrfs-progs/pull/877 the API is changing
to "--subvol <path>:ro,default" so let's adapt our usage to match.

This also adds support for read-only subvolumes.

Fixes https://github.com/systemd/systemd/issues/34134
pr_comments: Let's not merge this until the corresponding PR in btrfs-progs is merged
The corresponding PR in mkfs.btrfs was merged, so merging this as well

issue_context.title: mkfs.btrfs subvolume interface might change
issue_context.body:
Just for tracking, if the interface changes, we'll need to adapt systemd-repart to those changes before we release 257

https://github.com/kdave/btrfs-progs/pull/877
